questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Quantity of Wastewater & Storm Water Flow Estimation
questions.text: Explain Sewerage Systems: Separate, Combined, and Partially Separate systems. Compare their merits, demerits, and suitability in the Nepalese context.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Design of Sewer Systems & Sewer Appurtenances
questions.text: Explain Quantity of Sewage: Dry Weather Flow (DWF) and Storm Water Flow (Rational Formula: $Q = \frac{1}{360} C I A$). Explain design criteria for sewers (Self-cleansing velocity and non-scouring velocity). Design a circular sewer running partially full using Manning's formula.
Explain Sewer Appurtenances: Manholes (Drop Manhole, Deep Manhole), Inlets, Catch Basins, Inverted Siphons, and Grease Traps with diagrams.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Sludge Treatment, Anaerobic Digestion & Solid Waste Management
questions.text: Explain Characteristics of Sewage: Physical, Chemical (BOD, COD, DO, Total Solids). Derive BOD formula: $BOD_t = L_0 (1 - 10^{-K t})$. Given 5-day BOD at $20^\circ\text{C}$ is $200 \text{ mg/L}$ and $K_{20} = 0.1 \text{ day}^{-1}$, calculate ultimate first-stage BOD ($L_0$) and 3-day BOD at $25^\circ\text{C}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Sludge Treatment, Anaerobic Digestion & Solid Waste Management
questions.text: Explain Sewage Treatment: Primary Treatment (Screening, Grit Chamber, Primary Clarifier), Secondary Biological Treatment: Activated Sludge Process (ASP) vs Trickling Filter, Septic Tank design with Soak Pit for domestic wastewater, and Anaerobic Sludge Digestion.
